_comment: Curated cards shown at the top of benchmarks.html, in order. Blurbs are editorial copy; everything else on the card comes from data/benchmarks/<slug>.json.

featured.blurb: A unified evaluation for agentic coding ability. 8 task types, 8 programming scenarios, and 10 programming languages with 2,000 curated instances derived from authentic GitHub pull requests.
Graduate-level question answering across hundreds of specialized fields, probing how far frontier-model knowledge extends beyond the mainstream disciplines.
Audio-visual video understanding over long horizons: can omni models integrate what they see with what they hear, instead of answering from a single dominant modality?
Semantic alignment, temporal synchrony, and perceptual quality for text-to-audio-video generation systems — measuring what generative systems can truly produce.
Multimodal browsing beyond text trails: search agents must follow evidence through images, charts, and pages that no text-only pipeline can shortcut.
Knowledge-orthogonal reasoning in interactive game environments built on novel rules, separating genuine rule-following inference from pattern recall.
Long-video understanding stress-tested to the hour mark, with questions whose evidence is scattered across durations that defeat frame-sampling shortcuts.
Counter-intuitive instruction following: when the request contradicts the training prior, compliance means overriding the likely answer.
